question: Find the display name of the owner of the highest-scoring child post (i.e., a post with a non-null ParentId) created in 2011 by a user whose reputation exceeds 1000, and who has earned the 'Organizer' badge.

prediction.sql:
SELECT u.XCL_055
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.XCL_033 = u.XCL_052
JOIN badges b ON u.XCL_052 = b.XCL_002
WHERE p.XCL_040 IS NOT NULL
  AND strftime('%Y', p.XCL_029) = '2011'
  AND u.XCL_053 > 1000
  AND b.XCL_003 = 'Organizer'
ORDER BY p.XCL_031 DESC
LIMIT 1
